items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: Tadd did, Tad did quite a few things.

ctx.x: Tadd did, Tad did quite a few things. And Buster Harding used to write all the boogies, you know, like for Basie. He did the piano boogies. Buster Harding did that. He bought arrangements from everybody -- Skip Martin, Skip, I think, wrote "Miss Thing." Skip is a white saxophone player. Dave Matthews wrote some things for him. I don't know what became of Dave, that's my Texas friend. And just about everybody.
